current_task: Deterministic public retrieval replay is implemented and adversarially reviewed. Next: bind receipts to independently reproduced engine execution and signed multilingual dataset attestations, then collect same-input receipts from Naia and at least two global engines.
key_decisions: Use CPU only; GPU 1 belongs to another session.
Treat existing reports without revision, dataset digest, configuration, and environment as historical evidence, not certified comparisons.
Keep retrieval measurement separate from agent response and abstention decisions.
Do not adopt vector-only as the default: it improved hit@1 and MRR but increased forbidden-fact exposure at top-5 on the fixed Korean contract.
Discord DM delivery was verified through the configured alpha-ds-bot direct-message route; concise notices are reserved for material improvements.
Reject the RRF zero-score candidate: forbidden@1 rose from 25.0% to 31.3% and forbidden@5 from 43.8% to 50.0% on two reproducible CPU runs.

Separate structured-supersession mechanism evidence from broad retrieval evidence: the new fixed Korean/English/Japanese contract scores lifecycle preservation, retrieval relevance, and stale/foreign exposure without language-specific tuning.

Reject vector-only as a default candidate: on the structured contract it matched RRF safety and improved MRR only from 0.564 to 0.571, while the broad Korean contract still has higher forbidden@5 exposure (56.3% versus 43.8%).
Reject KG-spreading configuration as a quality candidate: disabling it produced identical results on all six Korean-contract measures, so this corpus contains no discriminating graph path.

Reject the global MMR-off candidate: it left every v2 multilingual and broad Korean contract metric unchanged, including Japanese entity-confusion retrieval; the bottleneck is candidate relevance before diversification.

Defer the optional CPU BGE reranker: the v2 ten-case run loaded successfully but exceeded eight minutes without a completed receipt. It cannot be accepted for quality and is unsuitable as a default CPU path without batched warm-run evidence.

Reject the corrected batched q8 BGE reranker as a ranking candidate: on v2 explicit structure, hit@5 rose 60.0% to 70.0% but hit@1 fell 40.0% to 30.0%, MRR fell 0.500 to 0.433, and the ten-case run cost 210.12 seconds with 1,729,480 KB max RSS. Keep the pair-scoring correctness fix optional; do not change the default path.

Correct benchmark case-state contamination: restore recallCount, lastAccessed, and strength before every measured query. Earlier sequential ranking values are superseded; independent broad Korean RRF is hit@1 50.0%, hit@5 81.3%, MRR 0.635, forbidden@1 31.3%, forbidden@5 56.3%.
Reject candidate-pool expansion: multipliers 6 and 12 were metric-identical to 3 on corrected v2 and broad Korean contracts, so configurable broad-factor product code was removed.

Supersede the pre-correction multilingual-e5-large rejection: two independent-case repetitions produced identical material gains. Broad Korean moved from 50.0/81.3/.635 to 68.8/87.5/.781 and forbidden@1 fell 31.3% to 12.5% while forbidden@5 stayed 56.3%; v2 moved from 40.0/70.0/.525 to 50.0/70.0/.570 with zero stale exposure and 100% lifecycle.

Keep E5-large as a measured candidate, not yet the default: max RSS was approximately 1.80-1.85 GB and the cached model is roughly 562 MB. Require a smaller-model quality/resource curve and Shell/Agent dimension compatibility gate.

Select multilingual-e5-small q8 as the resource-balanced candidate: two broad Korean runs reproduced 62.5% hit@1, 87.5% hit@5, 0.740 MRR, 18.8% forbidden@1, and 56.3% forbidden@5; v2 preserved 40.0/70.0/0.525, zero stale exposure, and 100% lifecycle at approximately 648-659 MB max RSS.

Reject multilingual-e5-base q8: it matched small hit@1/hit@5, reduced broad MRR from 0.740 to 0.729, and increased max RSS to approximately 0.97-1.04 GB; its lower forbidden@1 did not change forbidden@5.

Integration trace: the existing E5-large path is wired Shell settings -> Agent closed union -> Naia Memory, but E5-small is not accepted by the Shell/Agent unions. Do not claim small is product-selectable until separately authorized repository contracts update those boundaries.
Keep the lifecycle prefilter correctness fix: inactive rows can no longer starve active rows before candidate truncation; targeted regression tests pass, with no quality-score uplift claimed.

Block any embedding default switch until storage migration is explicit: Local JSON persists vectors without model identity, so same-dimension MiniLM to E5-small can silently mix incompatible vector spaces; SQLite vec0 can retain an incompatible dimension schema.

Implement the Local JSON migration floor: persist a preprocessing-versioned embedding-space ID, fail loudly on mismatched or unidentified vectors, and require explicit full reindex before recall. SQLite and Agent/Shell gates remain open.
Require verifier-owned Ed25519 trust roots for publisher, engine, and reviewer identities; submitted evidence cannot select its own trust root.
Pin each approved scoring policy to an exact scorer artifact SHA-256 and bind every case judgment to engine, case, repetition, output, score, failure state, and policy identity.
Keep the public benchmark claim blocked: the v3 gate implementation passed adversarial review, but independent multilingual corpus construction and real external-engine receipts remain absent.

Replay every public retrieval record from raw signed output under exact-current-hit-at-k-v1; bind top-k to the metric identity and fail a case when any forbidden or stale ID appears in the frozen window.

Do not equate deterministic receipt consistency with execution provenance: require verifier-issued run nonces, immutable adapter/configuration/executable digests, independent reproduction, and signed corpus author/native-reviewer attestations before public comparison.
